headline: Filatex India Limited: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Filatex India Limited has filed a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares or a takeover-triggering event. The specific acquirer identity, shareholding percentage, and deal value remain undisclosed in the public regulation notice.
detail: Filatex India Limited, a listed textile and industrial products manufacturer, has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to the NSE, which obligates any acquirer crossing 25% shareholding to disclose intent and launch an open offer to remaining shareholders. This filing is the first regulatory gate in a substantial acquisition sequence under the Takeover Code. The disclosure document (accessible via NSE archives) will specify the acquirer's identity, the target shareholding percentage, the acquisition route (creeping or direct), the mode of consideration, and the open offer price floor.
